title: next-doc configuration
description: Configuration for the next-doc CLI. Every key is optional. Unknown keys are rejected.

plugins.description: Plugins to run when none are named on the command line.

ignore.description: Extra glob patterns to exclude, appended to the defaults.

strict.description: Treat warnings as errors, so they fail the run too.

rules.description: Per rule overrides, keyed by the rule code shown in every finding.

required.description: Variables that must exist. Missing ones are errors.

optional.description: Platform provided variables. Never reported as missing or unused.

types.description: Expected value shapes. Mismatches are warnings, values are never printed.

allowPublic.description: Browser exposed variables that are public on purpose.

requiredHeaders.description: Headers that must appear in your header configuration.

headerFiles.description: Extra files to search for headers, for hosts next-doc does not know about.

maxRouteKb.description: Budget for the JavaScript a single route loads. Measured from real build output.

pathPatterns.description: Path fragments that mark a money handling route. Replaces the default list.

keywords.description: Extra markers that count as idempotency handling. Appended to the defaults.
